what: For each word, glyph boxes are measured and a vertical stroke and two diagonal strokes are made into masks, the strokes grow from the center to both ends (or from one end), revealing the text as if written with a brush — on open, words are fully written with .8s quint.out, each word .05s and each glyph .07s later, when hovering one word, it finishes writing in .85s while the others are erased in reverse in .65s. On leave, the touched word is rewritten in .45s and the others in .85s. A faint copy of the same word sits behind

options.in: Time for the hovered word to be written (s), default .85
options.out: Duration for the rest to fade out (s), default .65
options.back: Duration for the touched word to be rewritten on leave (sec), default .45
options.on: With manual, it doesn’t play even when entering the screen, only when fx:play is sent (when opening the menu panel). State cleared by fx:reset

note: The original drew hand-drawn stroke paths per word (2–7 mask lines per letter) with drawSVG. Those paths are not carried over. Instead, so it works with any font and word, vertical and diagonal strokes are built from the glyph box and drawn at the same tempo (the stroke shape doesn’t follow the letterform). Drawn with dasharray, without drawSVG
